Create `solution.rs` for a small checked integer expression evaluator. Define public enums `Expr` and `EvalError`, both deriving `Debug`, `Clone`, `PartialEq`, and `Eq`. `Expr` must have `Number(i64)`, `Name(String)`, `Add(Box<Expr>, Box<Expr>)`, `Multiply(Box<Expr>, Box<Expr>)`, and `Assign(String, Box<Expr>)`. `EvalError` must have `UnknownName(String)`, `Overflow`, and `EmptyName`. Define `pub type Scope = std::collections::BTreeMap<String, i64>` and expose `pub fn eval(expr: &Expr, scope: &mut Scope) -> Result<i64, EvalError>`. Numbers return themselves; names resolve existing bindings; arithmetic evaluates left before right and uses checked operations; assignment rejects an empty name, evaluates its value, then inserts or replaces the binding and returns that value. If any evaluation fails, assignment must not change its target binding. Arithmetic and name lookup must not mutate the scope. Provide no `main` function.
